end.summary:
Practised how tree roots reduce soil erosion and help water sources last longer; this is partly right and needs checking next time.
Practised examples: Bishnoi protecting khejri and blackbuck, sacred groves, and Chipko; examples were partly right and need checking next time.
Compared benefits of living trees with cut trees, including shade, fruit, shelter and food for animals.
Initially placed responsibility for protecting forests mainly on the government; later added that people can protect trees and provide water for birds.
end.parentNote: Dev practised linking tree roots with less soil loss and longer-lasting water, and named Bishnoi, sacred groves and Chipko practices. The mix-up about only the government protecting forests was corrected later when Dev suggested not cutting park trees and keeping water for birds. At home, ask Dev to match each example—Bishnoi, sacred groves and Chipko—with the nature-protecting action, then explain one benefit.
